EditorMetadata.Comment: P1b tree-INTEGRATION (architect Q#9-A): PlatoonHillAttack2 -- same STRUCTURE as PlatoonHillAttack.btree.json (Sequence(CalculateSegments, DispatchAllToBaseline, AreAllAtBaseline, Repeater(Sequence(RequestAreaQuery, IsAreaQueryResolved, DispatchWaveWithTargets, IsWaveCompleted)))), and every node except AreAllAtBaseline is bound to the INTEGRATED HillAssault2I_* blueprint thunks (DelegateShape:AiPrimitiveTickCore, mirroring HillAssault2I_Smoke.btree.json), which converse over the single standalone 'state' HillAttackSharedState slot (Role=State/Scope=Entity) instead of each owning a private WorkingState. IsWaveCompleted is now INCLUDED as the wave loop's 4th child (HillAssault2I_IsWaveCompleted.bp.json, this PR): its curated WaveMonitorOps.Update/ActiveCount(HillAttackSharedState,...) tree-integration overloads project ActiveRunners/BurnedSlotsMask/BaselineReservedMask into a WaveState, reuse the proven swap-remove kernel, and write the fields back -- so the wave loop is Sequence(RequestAreaQuery, IsAreaQueryResolved, DispatchWaveWithTargets, IsWaveCompleted), matching PlatoonHillAttack.btree.json's structure exactly. AreAllAtBaseline is the UNCHANGED isolated twin (HillAssault2_AreAllAtBaseline, node-local WorkingState only, no shared-state reads/writes) composed the same AiPrimitiveTickCore way, per the task's explicit allowance.
Setup (calc slots -> move to baseline -> wait for arrival) then the repeating wave loop.

Composes the generated HillAssault2I_CalculateSegments blueprint (Assets/Blueprints/HillAssault2I_CalculateSegments.bp.json, already committed/proven in Step 2). Writes TotalSlots (+ zeroes the other shared masks/handles) into the shared 'state' slot via its own GetShared/SetShared graph nodes.

Composes HillAssault2I_DispatchAllToBaseline.bp.json (this PR). Publishes MoveToLocation intents and writes BaselineReservedMask into the SAME shared 'state' slot CalculateSegments just wrote TotalSlots into -- cross-node shared-state flow, asserted by the proof.

Composes the EXISTING isolated twin HillAssault2_AreAllAtBaseline.bp.json unmodified -- node-local WorkingState (AllAtBaseline bool) only, no shared HillAttackSharedState reads/writes, so no integrated version was needed (task instructions).
One wave: EQS scan -> resolve -> dispatch -> wait for the dispatched wave's runners to finish/die before re-polling. Repeater(-1) repeats until IsAreaQueryResolved returns Failure (area clear).

Composes HillAssault2I_RequestAreaQuery.bp.json (this PR). Reads/writes CachedEqsRequestId + EqsRequestTime through the shared 'state' slot. bpParamsRequestAreaQuery.TargetAreaEntity is left at its zero default (Entity.Null) -- the proof does not drive the tree far enough to reach this node (it asserts cross-node state flow after the setup Sequence, per the task spec), so no real EQS target-area entity is provisioned here.
Composes HillAssault2I_IsAreaQueryResolved.bp.json (this PR). Reads/writes CachedEqsRequestId + CachedTargetGroupHandle + EqsRequestTime through the shared 'state' slot.

Composes HillAssault2I_DispatchWaveWithTargets.bp.json (this PR, the largest transform). Reads TotalSlots/BurnedSlotsMask/WaveUsedSlotsMask/BaselineReservedMask/CachedEqsRequestId/CachedTargetGroupHandle/CurrentWave and writes ActiveRunners/WaveUsedSlotsMask/BaselineReservedMask/CachedTargetGroupHandle/CachedEqsRequestId/EqsRequestTime/CurrentWave, all through the SAME shared 'state' slot.

Composes HillAssault2I_IsWaveCompleted.bp.json (this PR) -- the 4th and final wave-loop node, previously omitted. Reads+writes ActiveRunners/BurnedSlotsMask/BaselineReservedMask through the SAME shared 'state' slot via the curated WaveMonitorOps.Update(HillAttackSharedState,ISimulationView)/ActiveCount(HillAttackSharedState) tree-integration overloads (thin adapters over the proven WaveState swap-remove kernel). Returns Success once ActiveRunners is empty (wave complete), Running otherwise.

Pills.Comment: Repeat waves forever; the loop exits when IsAreaQueryResolved returns Failure (area clear).
